status_definitions.fixed: The old failure condition is no longer present, supported by a current test, an adapted recheck, or direct source evidence.
status_definitions.still_reproducible: An adapted v3.1.0 recheck or direct current control flow still demonstrates the old failure condition.
status_definitions.changed: The relevant public interface or documented behavior was replaced, so the old reproducer is no longer a like-for-like test.
status_definitions.not_retested: The old behavior could not be checked with the available offline environment or current interface.

upstream_test_run.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/pathview-v3-cache MPLBACKEND=Agg MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/pathview-v3-mpl .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q sources/pathview-plus/tests --junitxml=results/v3-audit/upstream-tests.xml
upstream_test_run.failure_environment_note: The test creates a subprocess environment containing only PATH and PYTHONPATH. In this restricted workspace that subprocess falls back to /Users/summermalik/.cache/pathview-plus, where writes are denied. The other cache-dependent tests passed when XDG_CACHE_HOME pointed to /tmp.

adapted_recheck_evidence.PV-BUG-003: The Python API accepted output_format='jpg' and output_format='PNG' even though the documented choices are png, pdf, and svg. Empty input failed as FileNotFoundError and 'banana' failed in Matplotlib, not in pathview's API validation.
adapted_recheck_evidence.PV-BUG-006: With map_null=False and one matched gene, plot_data_gene still had 27 rows while only 1 row carried a value.
adapted_recheck_evidence.PV-BUG-007: One completely unmatched input ID with min_nnodes=1 returned a truthy result with 64 layout nodes and plot_data_gene=None.
adapted_recheck_evidence.PV-BUG-010: pathview('mmu00020', species='hsa') looked for hsammu00020.xml and raised PathwayNotFoundError rather than rejecting the conflicting prefix.
adapted_recheck_evidence.PV-BUG-020: Two KGML entries with id='1' parsed successfully and the second entry overwrote the first.
adapted_recheck_evidence.PV-BUG-021: A KGML line with coords='10,20,30,40' parsed with x=None, y=None, width=46, height=17.
adapted_recheck_evidence.PV-BUG-027: Nested SBGN control points (20,20) and (25,20) were omitted; only start, next, and end coordinates remained.
adapted_recheck_evidence.PV-BUG-034: A 120x100 native background saved as a 792x664 output with title, key, and signature disabled at dpi=100.
adapted_recheck_evidence.PV-BUG-038: Graph rendering reduced two colors per node to one node_color entry per node.
adapted_recheck_evidence.PV-BUG-049: route_edge_spline(..., routing_mode='banana') returned a finite (30,2) curve rather than rejecting the mode.
adapted_recheck_evidence.PV-BUG-057: A mocked HTTP 200 HTML body for a PNG was written to hsa00020.png and reported as succeed. XML now has a content check, so this is a partial fix only.
adapted_recheck_evidence.PV-BUG-061: The generated KEGG conversion URL still used /conv/cpd/ rather than /conv/compound/.
adapted_recheck_evidence.PV-BUG-064: Uppercase Reactome/PANTHER IDs resolved, while lowercase forms returned null.
adapted_recheck_evidence.PV-BUG-069: render_node_svg replaced a transparent fill with the theme's unmapped color.
adapted_recheck_evidence.PV-BUG-075: _symbol_labels returned an empty label map for a gene whose existing label was the Entrez text '7157'.
